lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters along the dorsal-lateral surface, organized into approximately four longitudinal rows between the central and lateral carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands are visible crossing the longitudinal axes; white spots are centered at the intersection of these vertical bands and horizontal carinae-defined planes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper flank, showing a sharp light-to-dark transition moving ventrally.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance spots, with approximately six distinct points visible on the trailing lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the lower lateral flank, posterior to the right pectoral fin; no permanent tissue trauma or amputations are clearly visible.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper lobe of the caudal fin displays a high-contrast pattern of discrete, isolated spots contrasting against the lower-luminance background.
